Крім того, Forbo Flotex володіє протиковзкими властивостями і в сухому, і у вологому вигляді.
7e58d285c5e96d5578bea3b1648afcc5.en:
A special resilient backing has excellent sound-insulating properties and can dampen impact sound by up to 20 dB. More than 80 million nylon flocks (textile fibres) per square metre of carpet tile create an exceptionally hard-wearing surface.

Thanks to its particular surface structure, Forbo Flotex holds dirt, dust and allergens within the surface, keeping the air clean and safe for people with allergies. All the dirt then lifts out easily with ordinary vacuuming.

On top of that, Forbo Flotex is slip-resistant both dry and wet.

The main advantages:

  • Immediate use — there is no waiting for glue to dry. You can not only walk on it but start moving furniture in.
